_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your SQL Server details. config.json is gitignored so credentials never get committed.
_filter_comment: Optional. The Excel->SQL loader only inserts rows whose Fiscal_Week (YYYYWW) is within this range. Set to keep e.g. 2025-2027 only; remove both keys to load all years. CLI --min-week/--max-week override these.
